module AlphaFold3

import Data.Vect
import Data.List
import Data.Nat
import Data.Fin
import Data.Maybe
import Data.String
import Control.Monad.State
import System

data AtomType = C | N | O | S | H | P | Other Nat

Eq AtomType where
  C == C = True
  N == N = True
  O == O = True
  S == S = True
  H == H = True
  P == P = True
  (Other n) == (Other m) = n == m
  _ == _ = False

data Atom : Type where
  MkAtom : (index : Nat) -> (atomtype : AtomType) -> (coords : Vect 3 Double) -> (present : Bool) -> Atom

data BondType = Single | Double | Triple | Aromatic | OtherBond String

data Bond : Type where
  MkBond : (atom1 : Nat) -> (atom2 : Nat) -> (bondType : BondType) -> Bond

data ResidueType = ALA | ARG | ASN | ASP | CYS | GLN | GLU | GLY | HIS | ILE | LEU | LYS | MET | PHE | PRO | SER | THR | TRP | TYR | VAL | UNK

Eq ResidueType where
  ALA == ALA = True
  ARG == ARG = True
  ASN == ASN = True
  ASP == ASP = True
  CYS == CYS = True
  GLN == GLN = True
  GLU == GLU = True
  GLY == GLY = True
  HIS == HIS = True
  ILE == ILE = True
  LEU == LEU = True
  LYS == LYS = True
  MET == MET = True
  PHE == PHE = True
  PRO == PRO = True
  SER == SER = True
  THR == THR = True
  TRP == TRP = True
  TYR == TYR = True
  VAL == VAL = True
  UNK == UNK = True
  _ == _ = False

data Residue : Type where
  MkResidue : (index : Nat) -> (resType : ResidueType) -> (atoms : List Atom) -> (present : Bool) -> (centerIdx : Nat) -> (distoIdx : Nat) -> Residue

data ChainType = Protein | RNA | DNA | NonPolymer

Eq ChainType where
  Protein == Protein = True
  RNA == RNA = True
  DNA == DNA = True
  NonPolymer == NonPolymer = True
  _ == _ = False

data Chain : Type where
  MkChain : (index : Nat) -> (chainId : String) -> (residues : List Residue) -> (molType : ChainType) -> (symId : Nat) -> (asymId : Nat) -> (entityId : Nat) -> (clusterId : String) -> (valid : Bool) -> (cyclicPeriod : Nat) -> Chain

data Interface : Type where
  MkInterface : (chain1 : Nat) -> (chain2 : Nat) -> (valid : Bool) -> Interface

data Structure : Type where
  MkStructure : (chains : List Chain) -> (interfaces : List Interface) -> (bonds : List Bond) -> (connections : List Bond) -> Structure

data AminoAcid : Type where
  A : AminoAcid
  R : AminoAcid
  Asn : AminoAcid
  D : AminoAcid
  Cys : AminoAcid
  Q : AminoAcid
  E : AminoAcid
  G : AminoAcid
  His : AminoAcid
  Ile : AminoAcid
  Leu : AminoAcid
  K : AminoAcid
  Met : AminoAcid
  Phe : AminoAcid
  Pro : AminoAcid
  Ser : AminoAcid
  Thr : AminoAcid
  Trp : AminoAcid
  Tyr : AminoAcid
  Val : AminoAcid

data MSA : Type where
  MkMSA : (sequences : List (List AminoAcid)) -> (profile : List (List Double)) -> MSA

record TokenData where
  constructor MkTokenData
  tokenIdx : Nat
  atomIdx : Nat
  atomNum : Nat
  resIdx : Nat
  resType : Nat
  symId : Nat
  asymId : Nat
  entityId : Nat
  molType : Nat
  centerIdx : Nat
  distoIdx : Nat
  centerCoords : Vect 3 Double
  distoCoords : Vect 3 Double
  resolvedMask : Bool
  distoMask : Bool
  cyclicPeriod : Nat

record Tokenized where
  constructor MkTokenized
  tokenDataList : List TokenData
  tokenBonds : List (Nat, Nat)
  structure : Structure
  msa : MSA
  residueConstraints : List Nat

record Input where
  constructor MkInput
  structure : Structure
  msa : MSA
  residueConstraints : List Nat

record Outputs where
  constructor MkOutputs
  z : List (List (List Double))
  s : List (List Double)
  sInputs : List Double
  xPredicted : List (List (Vect 3 Double))
  plddt : List Double
  pae : List (List Double))
  pde : List (List Double))
  ptm : Double
  iptm : Double
  pPae : List (List Double))

resTypeToNat : ResidueType -> Nat
resTypeToNat ALA = 0
resTypeToNat ARG = 1
resTypeToNat ASN = 2
resTypeToNat ASP = 3
resTypeToNat CYS = 4
resTypeToNat GLN = 5
resTypeToNat GLU = 6
resTypeToNat GLY = 7
resTypeToNat HIS = 8
resTypeToNat ILE = 9
resTypeToNat LEU = 10
resTypeToNat LYS = 11
resTypeToNat MET = 12
resTypeToNat PHE = 13
resTypeToNat PRO = 14
resTypeToNat SER = 15
resTypeToNat THR = 16
resTypeToNat TRP = 17
resTypeToNat TYR = 18
resTypeToNat VAL = 19
resTypeToNat UNK = 20

isStandardRes : ResidueType -> Bool
isStandardRes UNK = False
isStandardRes _ = True

allAtoms : Structure -> List Atom
allAtoms (MkStructure chains _ _ _) = concatMap getChainAtoms chains
  where
    getChainAtoms : Chain -> List Atom
    getChainAtoms (MkChain _ _ residues _ _ _ _ _ _ _) = concatMap getResidueAtoms residues
    getResidueAtoms : Residue -> List Atom
    getResidueAtoms (MkResidue _ _ atoms _ _ _) = atoms

findAtomByIndex : Structure -> Nat -> Atom
findAtomByIndex s idx =
  case find (\(MkAtom i _ _ _) => i == idx) (allAtoms s) of
    Nothing => MkAtom 0 (Other 0) [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] False
    Just a => a

chainToId : Chain -> Nat
chainToId (MkChain _ _ _ Protein _ _ _ _ _ _) = 0
chainToId (MkChain _ _ _ RNA _ _ _ _ _ _) = 1
chainToId (MkChain _ _ _ DNA _ _ _ _ _ _) = 2
chainToId (MkChain _ _ _ NonPolymer _ _ _ _ _ _) = 3

tokenizeStandardRes : Chain -> Nat -> Structure -> Residue -> Nat -> TokenData
tokenizeStandardRes chain mType struct (MkResidue idx resType atoms present centerIdx distoIdx) tokenIdx =
  let centerAtom = findAtomByIndex struct centerIdx
      distoAtom = findAtomByIndex struct distoIdx
      MkAtom _ _ cCoords isPresent = centerAtom
      MkAtom _ _ dCoords isDPresent = distoAtom
      isTokenPresent = present && isPresent
      isDistoPresent = present && isDPresent
      resTypeId = resTypeToNat resType
      MkChain _ _ _ _ symId asymId entityId _ _ cyclicPeriod = chain
  in MkTokenData tokenIdx idx (length atoms) idx resTypeId symId asymId entityId mType centerIdx distoIdx cCoords dCoords isTokenPresent isDistoPresent cyclicPeriod

tokenizeNonStandardRes : Chain -> Nat -> Structure -> Residue -> Nat -> List TokenData
tokenizeNonStandardRes chain mType struct (MkResidue idx resType atoms present centerIdx distoIdx) startTokenIdx =
  let unkId = 20
      MkChain _ _ _ _ symId asymId entityId _ _ cyclicPeriod = chain
      atomSlice = atoms
  in mapWithIndex (\i, (MkAtom atomIdx atype coords apresent) =>
       MkTokenData (startTokenIdx + i) atomIdx 1 idx unkId symId asymId entityId mType atomIdx atomIdx coords coords (present && apresent) (present && apresent) cyclicPeriod) atomSlice

mapWithIndex : (Nat -> a -> b) -> List a -> List b
mapWithIndex f [] = []
mapWithIndex f xs = mapWithIndexHelper 0 f xs
  where
    mapWithIndexHelper : Nat -> (Nat -> a -> b) -> List a -> List b
    mapWithIndexHelper _ _ [] = []
    mapWithIndexHelper n f (x :: xs) = f n x :: mapWithIndexHelper (S n) f xs

tokenizeRes : Chain -> Nat -> Structure -> Residue -> Nat -> (List TokenData, Nat)
tokenizeRes chain mType struct res@(MkResidue _ resType _ present _ _) currentTokenIdx =
  if not present
    then ([], currentTokenIdx)
    else if isStandardRes resType
           then ([tokenizeStandardRes chain mType struct res currentTokenIdx], S currentTokenIdx)
           else let tokens = tokenizeNonStandardRes chain mType struct res currentTokenIdx
                in (tokens, currentTokenIdx + length tokens)

tokenizeChain : Chain -> Nat -> Structure -> Nat -> (List TokenData, Nat)
tokenizeChain (MkChain _ _ residues _ _ _ _ _ _ _) mType struct currentTokenIdx =
  foldl (\(acc, idx), res => let (tokens, newIdx) = tokenizeRes (MkChain 0 "" residues Protein 0 0 0 "" True 0) mType struct res idx
                             in (acc ++ tokens, newIdx))
        ([], currentTokenIdx)
        residues

buildAtomToToken : List TokenData -> List (Nat, Nat)
buildAtomToToken tds = concatMap expandToken tds
  where
    expandToken : TokenData -> List (Nat, Nat)
    expandToken td = replicate (atomNum td) (atomIdx td, tokenIdx td)

lookupAtomToToken : List (Nat, Nat) -> Nat -> Nat
lookupAtomToToken [] _ = 0
lookupAtomToToken ((aIdx, tIdx) :: rest) atom =
  if aIdx == atom then tIdx else lookupAtomToToken rest atom

tokenize : Input -> Tokenized
tokenize (MkInput struct msa residueConstraints) =
  let MkStructure chains interfaces bonds connections = struct
      validChains = filter isValidChain chains
      molTypes = map chainToId validChains
      (tokenDataList, _) = foldl processChain ([], 0) (zip validChains molTypes)
      atomToTokenMap = buildAtomToToken tokenDataList
      tokenBondsList = mapMaybe (processBond atomToTokenMap) bonds
      tokenConnsList = mapMaybe (processBond atomToTokenMap) connections
      allBonds = tokenBondsList ++ tokenConnsList
  in MkTokenized tokenDataList allBonds struct msa residueConstraints
  where
    isValidChain : Chain -> Bool
    isValidChain (MkChain _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ valid _) = valid

    processChain : (List TokenData, Nat) -> (Chain, Nat) -> (List TokenData, Nat)
    processChain (acc, idx) (chain, mType) =
      let (tokens, newIdx) = tokenizeChain chain mType struct idx
      in (acc ++ tokens, newIdx)

    processBond : List (Nat, Nat) -> Bond -> Maybe (Nat, Nat)
    processBond atomMap (MkBond a1 a2 _) =
      let t1 = lookupAtomToToken atomMap a1
          t2 = lookupAtomToToken atomMap a2
      in if t1 > 0 && t2 > 0 then Just (t1, t2) else Nothing
